articles.title_en: Ukraine invokes U.N. Charter in defense of its strike on Russian warship in Libya
articles.lead_en: Kyiv says the strike on the Russian corvette Merkuriy off the coast of Libya did not expand the war’s geographic scope but was simply an exercise of Ukraine’s lawful right to self-defense.
